gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-kameron: Cherry Swash bends like glass tubing, diagonals as heavy as verticals, while Kameron tempers its curves with mild thick-thin shifts. Big, short headings are where Cherry Swash earns its keep.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-libertinus-serif: Cherry Swash is all unshaded wire and horseshoe curves. It does its best work in big display lines, while Libertinus Serif shows its strength in quieter lines, with sturdy downstrokes and slender turns.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-libre-caslon-text: Commanding up top, Cherry Swash has no pinched joints or flared ends, while Libre Caslon Text keeps sturdy hairlines. Pages of it would go down gently, thanks to that low-key thick-thin variation.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-lustria: A horseshoe-wide c opens Cherry Swash, whose strokes stay as constant as bent wire, while Lustria shifts weight without drama. Wire-like heading, moderate body: that gap is its charm.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-maitree: Cherry Swash is bent wire with a horseshoe c. Maitree brings a mellow thick-thin swell the heading never offers, and that gap between flat wire and gentle curves is the draw.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-marcellus: Refined and lightly etched, the body reads like lines in glass, beneath Cherry Swash's flat, unvaried strokes. Marcellus gives moderate thick-thin shifts where the heading gives none, and that gap is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-martel: Martel carries moderate contrast and apertures like a horseshoe magnet's open end, under Cherry Swash's unmodulated, single-weight lines. Cherry Swash grabs attention up top; Martel does the quiet work below.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-mate: Dignified Mate cups its round letters and tapers softly, like a sharpened pencil, under Cherry Swash's gliding wire line. Wire meets carpenter's pencil, and that texture gap is the draw.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-mate-sc: Cherry Swash is flat, stressless and boldly open-mouthed. Mate SC brings a faint nib-pressure variation and brush-lifted curve ends, so beside it the heading feels blunt and the body feels dignified.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-nanum-myeongjo: Cherry Swash runs a single stroke width through the whole alphabet, with a wide horseshoe c. Nanum Myeongjo thins its diagonals slightly, as if gently pressed, and keeps its curve tips apart.
